readmeMarkdown:
# Antigravity Local File Launcher

An **Antigravity 2.0 Plugin & MCP App** that lets you jump directly to any local folder in **Windows File Explorer / macOS Finder / Linux file manager** and open generated documents (Word `.docx`, `.pdf`, Excel `.xlsx`, PowerPoint `.pptx`, images, archives, etc.) with your system's default application — directly from clickable cards inside the chat or side pane.

一款专为 **Antigravity 2.0 桌面客户端** 打造的轻量级本地插件（Plugin + MCP App）：在聊天对话和右侧边栏中直接渲染可点击文件卡片，一键 **打开所在文件夹并高亮选中文件**、**用系统默认程序打开文档（Word / PDF / Excel / PPT 等）** 或 **复制完整本地路径**。

---

## Features / 核心功能

- **One-click interactive file cards in chat (`show_file_cards`)**: Automatically renders clean, theme-aware cards whenever the agent finishes creating local deliverables, with **Reveal in Folder / 打开文件夹**, **Open File / 打开文件**, and **Copy Path / 复制路径** buttons.
- **Side pane & sidebar Local Files browser (`browse_local_files`)**: Open **Local Files** from the `+` side-pane menu or left sidebar to browse folders, switch quick locations (Workspace, OneDrive, Desktop, Documents, Downloads), and launch files directly.
- **Direct agent tools (`reveal_in_explorer`, `open_file`)**: Ask in natural language (e.g., *"Reveal the outputs folder"* or *"Open the generated PDF"*) and the agent launches it immediately.
- **Automatic bilingual UI (English / 简体中文)**: Automatically follows Antigravity's host locale (`zh` / `en`) and includes a one-click **`中文` / `EN`** switcher right in the card header.
- **Zero tokens on button clicks**: Clicking card buttons calls the local MCP server directly from the UI (`callServerTool`) without invoking the LLM.
- **100% local & privacy-safe**: No API keys, no remote servers, no telemetry.
- **Built-in execution guardrail**: `open_file` intentionally blocks direct launch of executable/script extensions (`.exe`, `.msi`, `.bat`, `.cmd`, `.ps1`, `.vbs`, `.js`, `.reg`, etc.). Those files can still be safely located via **Reveal in Folder**.

---

## Prerequisites / 前置要求

- [Google Antigravity 2.0](https://antigravity.google/)
- [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) (Python package & environment runner)

---

## Installation / 安装方式

Clone this repository directly into Antigravity's global plugins directory as `local-file-launcher`. Antigravity discovers it automatically without requiring a restart (tools and skills take effect on the next conversation turn).

将本仓库克隆到 Antigravity 的全局插件目录 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/local-file-launcher` 即可自动加载（无需重启客户端，下一轮对话生效）：

### Windows (PowerShell)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Ray2w/antigravity-local-file-launcher.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\local-file-launcher"
```

### macOS / Linux

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Ray2w/antigravity-local-file-launcher.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/local-file-launcher
```

### Optional: Faster Offline Startup / 可选：本机预建环境实现毫秒级冷启动

By default, `mcp_config.json` uses `uv run --no-project --with mcp>=2.0`, which works across all platforms with zero setup. If you want instant offline startup on Windows, you can pre-install a local `.venv` inside the plugin folder and point `mcp_config.json`'s `command` to that `.venv/Scripts/python.exe`.

---

## Usage / 使用方式

1. **Automatic deliverable cards**: After the agent generates `.docx`, `.pdf`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`, `.csv`, `.zip`, or images, the bundled rule (`rules/AGENTS.md`) prompts the agent to display clickable launch cards automatically.
2. **Natural-language commands**:
   - *"Show clickable launch cards for the Word and PDF files in this folder"*
   - *"Reveal the outputs folder in File Explorer"*
   - *"Open the generated PDF"*
3. **Side pane browser**: Click `+` in the Antigravity auxiliary pane (or the left sidebar) and choose **Local Files**.
4. **Manage / disable / uninstall**: Open Antigravity **Customizations** -> **Local File Launcher** to toggle or remove the plugin at any time.

---

## Supported File Types & Safety / 支持的文件类型与安全机制

- **Reveal in Folder (`reveal_in_explorer`)**: Supports **all** files and directories on Windows (`explorer.exe /select,"<path>"`), macOS (`open -R`), and Linux (`xdg-open`).
- **Open File (`open_file`)**: Supports any non-executable file associated with a default OS application (`.docx`, `.pdf`, `.xlsx`, `.pptx`, `.md`, `.txt`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.svg`, `.zip`, `.csv`, scientific formats like `.cif`/`.pdb`/`.opju`, and folders).
- **Blocked from direct execution**: `.exe`, `.msi`, `.bat`, `.cmd`, `.com`, `.scr`, `.ps1`, `.psm1`, `.vbs`, `.vbe`, `.js`, `.jse`, `.wsf`, `.wsh`, `.hta`, `.reg`, `.cpl`, `.dll`.

---

## Running Tests / 运行测试

```powershell
uv run --no-project --with "mcp>=2.0" python tests/test_server.py
```

---

## Project Structure / 目录结构

```text
antigravity-local-file-launcher/
├── plugin.json                      # Antigravity plugin manifest
├── mcp_config.json                  # Cross-platform MCP server config (via uv)
├── README.md                        # Documentation
├── LICENSE                          # MIT License
├── THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md          # Third-party license notices
├── assets/
│   └── logo.svg                     # Plugin icon
├── rules/
│   └── AGENTS.md                    # Always-on rule to surface cards for deliverables
├── skills/
│   └── local-file-launcher/
│       └── SKILL.md                 # Skill usage guide
├── server/
│   ├── server.py                    # FastMCP / MCPServer 2.x stdio server
│   ├── card.html                    # Self-contained MCP App interactive UI
│   └── ext-apps.bundle.mjs          # Bundled @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps SDK
└── tests/
    └── test_server.py               # Automated stdio MCP protocol tests
```

---
